messages:
Samir: Heads-up — EU spare pool down to 6 H100s. Vendor offered an overnight RMA repair into FRA depot for +€3k/unit. Need decision whether to pay expedite or hold allocation. They can consolidate AWB to a single airwaybill to reduce customs risk but need proforma/PO quickly.

Jess: How big is the ETA gap vs standard replacement?

Samir: Standard RMA ~3-5 business days. Overnight promise is 24h transit but customs/airport handoff can add 12–18h. Vendor says with consolidated AWB and pre-alert we can usually avoid extra holds.

Raul: Depot accepts inbound 06:00–18:00 CET. If arrival after 18:00 we pay dock standby €250/pallet. Also need palletization dims.

Marie: If we do expedite, which clusters are prioritized? Prod EU or infra spares?

Samir: Priority to redwood-prod-eu (4 units), remaining 2 to spare pool. We'll tag routing in the manifest.

Jess: Alternative: reroute 4 from our US standby. Shipping baseline ~72h but customs clearance historically reliable. Cost?

Raul: Rough numbers: US->EU air + import ~€7k/unit. Vendor overnight €3k/unit but higher chance of customs snag. Overnight cheaper if it clears.

Vendor-Luis: Luis (NexaSupply): We can consolidate into a single AWB. AWB will be:
```
NLX1234567890
```
We need PO number and a proforma invoice for pre-alert. Depot can accept palletized crates, max 2 pallets per AWB. We'll provide tracking and arrival ETAs.

Samir: Send proforma to ops@redwood.com and include serials for the returning units. We must ensure return-to-vendor serial mapping to avoid chargebacks.

Logistics-bot: Inbound record created. Tentative ETA FRA: 2026-03-22T14:30Z. AWB NLX1234567890. Depot cut 18:00 CET. :eyes:

Marie: If customs holds them, fallback plan? Can we hot-swap with US shipments and crossclear? That adds ~36–48h.

Jess: I'm okay to approve overnight for up to 4 units if finance signs off. :thumbsup:

Finance-Bot: Routing approval request to finance-approvals. Quote cap needed. Emergency cap requested: €12,000 tonight.

Anika: I approve up to €12k for emergency spares. Proceed for 4 units.

Samir: Confirmed. @Vendor-Luis proceed with consolidation and send proforma + serial list. Ops will stage for depot receipt and mapping.

Vendor-Luis: On it — proforma emailed, serial list attached to the email. AWB live and customs pre-alert sent.

Logistics-bot: Customs update: released at 2026-03-22T12:10Z. Delivery ETA updated to 2026-03-22T15:40Z to FRA depot. No additional duties applied. Depot confirmed pallet intake before 18:00 CET.

Samir: Thanks all — routing applied as discussed (4->prod, 2->spare). Closing thread after handoff.
